name: Build Marketing Operating Plan
summary: Build a constrained marketing operating plan that ties choices, owners, evidence, and review cadence.
description: Build a marketing operating plan from business stage, customer evidence, growth constraint, economics, positioning, capacity, and measurement. Use when a team needs coordinated priorities and operating decisions rather than a broad collection of tactics.
refuses: It does not produce an exhaustive channel checklist or invented revenue forecast.
It does not assign work or spend beyond documented authority and capacity.
It does not hide tradeoffs, dependencies, rejected options, or weak assumptions.
